categorization.name: Email Categorization
categorization.template: Categorize this email as Important, Newsletter, Spam, or To-Do. Email from {from_} about {subject}. Body: {body}. Reply with just one word.

action_extraction.name: Action Item Extraction
action_extraction.template: Find tasks in this email from {from_}: {body}. Return empty array [] if no tasks, or JSON array with tasks.

auto_reply.name: Auto-Reply Draft
auto_reply.template: Write a short professional reply to this email. From: {from_}. Subject: {subject}. Body: {body}

summarization.name: Email Summarization
summarization.template: Summarize this email in one sentence. From: {from_}. Subject: {subject}. Body: {body}
